title: Emerald cut diamond ring with Cadillac side stones
subtitle: The emerald cut is a window. Step facets create a long, open plane of reflected light rather than the scattered fire of brilliant cuts — clarity is readable, depth is visible, and the geometry of the stone presents itself directly. Three step-cut forms in sequence — the emerald center and two kite-shaped Cadillac sides — compose a single rectangle of light across the finger. Each element was chosen so the whole reads as one form.
